principle: Reuse a canonical surface before creating another app. A backend, tool, console or feature does not become a new PWA by default.

installablePwas.name: Héctor OS
installablePwas.purpose: Main personal OS, chat, general controls, shared utilities and entry point.

installablePwas.name: Héctor Agent
installablePwas.purpose: Autonomous goals, task execution, approvals, activity, checkpoints and Agent controls.

installablePwas.name: Pendientes
installablePwas.rule: Do not modify unless the user explicitly authorizes work on Pendientes. Never move unrelated tools into this PWA.

sharedSurfaces.rule: Bridge and Bridge Core are one capability layer. Do not create another Bridge PWA; consolidate new Bridge UI into Héctor OS/Bridge.
Context Hub is shared context infrastructure, not an installable PWA. Any UI belongs in Héctor OS or Bridge.

creationRules: Before creating a PWA, inspect this registry and reuse an existing canonical surface when its purpose fits.
A new installable PWA requires explicit user authorization specifically to create a new PWA, not merely authorization to add a feature.
The same change that creates a new PWA must add it to this registry with a unique scope, manifest and service worker.
Pages, consoles, tools, APIs, brokers, memory layers and backend services attach to an existing owner PWA unless the user explicitly decides otherwise.
Never create overlapping service-worker scopes or cache ownership across registered PWAs.
Pendientes is protected and remains isolated from Héctor OS, Héctor Agent and Bridge work.
